title: 支持 The Bell of Silence | Aurefold
description: 跟随 The Bell of Silence 从完稿走向出版。免费加入 Aurefold，了解 Patreon 会员，并获取未来的众筹更新。
blocks:
Members receive closer access to the making of Aurefold. They do not purchase
        authority over its canon. The ten Houses, the central plot, the characters' fates,
        and the unresolved mysteries remain the responsibility of the author. What the Moot
        can shape is the world around the book — which supplemental material, art, or topic
        the archive opens next, and bounded extras like which side-story gets written or the
        name of a minor figure in the supplementary lore. The heart of the story stays the
        author's, and no vote is bought — one voice per reader.
会员得到的是更贴近 Aurefold 创作过程的机会。他们并不购买对其正典的权威。十大家族、核心情节、角色的命运以及尚未解开的谜题，始终由作者负责。议会所能塑造的是本书周边的世界——档案接下来开放哪些补充材料、画作或主题，以及有边界的附加内容，例如写哪一则外传，或补充设定中某个次要人物的名字。故事的核心始终属于作者，任何一票都无法用钱买到——每位读者一票。

Does membership influence the story?

The central plot, canon, and the book's unresolved mysteries are the author's alone. What the community can shape through the Moot is the world around the book — which material or art the archive opens next, and bounded extras like which side-story gets written or a minor figure's name in the supplementary lore. Membership brings closer access to how Aurefold is made, not authority over its canon.

会员身份会影响故事吗？

核心情节、正典以及本书尚未解开的谜题，唯属作者一人。社群通过议会所能塑造的是本书周边的世界——档案接下来开放哪些材料或画作，以及有边界的附加内容，例如写哪一则外传，或补充设定中某个次要人物的名字。会员身份带来的是更贴近 Aurefold 创作过程的机会，而非对其正典的权威。

Book One doesn't begin with Sela. It begins in a sealed room, far from the
              valley, where three officials argue over a record they cannot fully trust.
              The choice is deliberate. Before you meet the girl, you meet the machine
              that will decide what she means — the witnessing, the wax seals, the burned
              trial notes, the sentence that closes every question by calling it
              answered.
第一部并非从 Sela 开始。它始于一间封闭的房间，远离山谷，三名官员在此为一份他们无法完全信任的记录争论不休。这个选择是刻意为之。在你遇见那个女孩之前，你先遇见了那台将裁定她意味着什么的机器——那些见证、那些蜡封、那些被焚毁的审讯记录，还有那道以“已作答”来终结每一个问题的判词。

Whitehart is called the house of faith, but faith is not what it guards. It exists to test — to stand between a person who says they heard something and a world that badly wants the question settled. A house built to doubt on everyone's behalf is a strange kind of church.
Whitehart 被称为信仰之家，但它所守护的并非信仰。它的存在是为了检验——立于一个自称听见了某事的人，与一个迫切想要了结此问题的世界之间。一个为众人代行怀疑而建的家族，是一种奇特的教会。

The Bell of Silence is a story about testimony: about a person who will say only what she knows, and a world that would rather settle the meaning of a silence than live with an open question. It's the kind of book I most want to read, so it's the kind of book I set out to write.
The Bell of Silence 是一个关于证词的故事：关于一个只肯说出自己所知之事的人，以及一个宁愿了结一段沉默的含义、也不愿与一个悬而未决的问题共处的世界。这正是我最想读的那类书，因此也是我着手去写的那类书。

Aurefold is being built in the open, and there's room for a few collaborators who want to help carry Book One to publication. These are pro bono roles — unpaid, but credited, with a real hand in how the book and its world reach readers. A few evenings a month is plenty.
Aurefold 正在公开地构建，也留有位置给少数几位愿意助力将第一部推向出版的合作者。这些是公益性质的角色——无偿，但会署名，并对本书及其世界如何抵达读者有着实实在在的参与。每月几个晚上便足矣。

Patreon supports the work leading to publication: reader testing, production
        planning, design development, and the campaign itself. The later crowdfunding
        campaign will be a separate, time-limited opportunity to help finance the book's
        final production and receive campaign rewards.
Patreon 支持通往出版的各项工作：读者测试、制作规划、设计推进，以及活动本身。之后的众筹活动将是一次独立、限时的机会，用以资助本书的最终制作，并获得活动回馈。

I could try to publish this book quietly and show you only the finished object.
          I'd rather do it in the open — share the road from a completed manuscript to a
          printed book, the good weeks and the slow ones, and let readers be part of it
          before the cover is even designed.
我本可以悄悄出版这本书，只把成品呈现给你们。但我更愿意公开去做——分享从完稿到印刷成书的历程，顺利的周与迟缓的周，让读者在封面尚未设计之前便成为其中的一部分。

Book One is written. The next work is turning a finished manuscript into a
        professionally edited, designed, printed, and delivered book. Join the Aurefold
        community for free, follow every major step, or become a member and help carry
        the work forward.
第一部已经写就。接下来的工作，是把一份完稿变成一本经过专业编辑、设计、印刷并送达读者手中的书。免费加入 Aurefold 社群，跟随每一个重要步骤，或成为会员，助力这项工作向前推进。

What that does to a reader, and why the whole novel is built to make you
              feel the record before you feel the person, is the part I want to walk
              through — including the two lines I cut, and the one I almost cut and
              didn't…
这对读者产生了怎样的作用，以及整部小说为何被构建成让你先感受到记录、再感受到人，是我想带你细细走过的部分——包括我删掉的那两行，以及我险些删掉却最终保留的那一行…
这篇手记深入探讨这个聆听之家实际如何运作——检验之仪，山谷为何既需要它又憎恶它，以及潜藏于这一切之下的无声恐惧：当检验者出错的那一天会发生什么…

When the crowdfunding campaign opens, every contribution goes into making and
        delivering the physical book — never into the story, which is already written.
        The work it pays for, roughly in order of cost:
众筹活动开启后，每一笔捐助都将用于制作和交付实体书——绝不用于故事本身，因为故事早已写就。它所支付的工作，大致按成本高低排列如下：

What will crowdfunding pay for?

The final production: proofreading, cover and interior design, typesetting, print proofs, and fulfilment. Exact costs will come from real quotes, not guesses.

众筹将支付哪些费用？

最终制作：校对、封面与内文设计、排版、印刷打样和发货。确切成本将来自真实报价，而非臆测。

What stage is it in?

Internal developmental revision is complete. Next comes external reader testing, then professional proofreading, cover and interior design, and print preparation.

目前处于哪个阶段？

内部结构性修订已完成。接下来是外部读者测试，然后是专业校对、封面与内文设计，以及印制准备。
Interested? Write to tobias.carneteg@gmail.com with the role and a little about your work. Every collaborator is credited.
有兴趣？请写信至 tobias.carneteg@gmail.com， 说明角色，并简要介绍你的作品。每一位合作者都会获得署名。

Why use Patreon before crowdfunding?

Patreon lets early readers follow the work and helps build the community that makes a later campaign viable. It supports the preparation itself.

为何在众筹之前先用 Patreon？

Patreon 让早期读者得以跟随创作，并有助于建立起使日后活动得以成立的社群。它支持的是筹备工作本身。

Members don't just get news — they get the making of the book. Here are two
        examples of the kind of thing that goes out. The openings are public; members
        read the rest.
会员得到的不只是消息——他们得到的是这本书的诞生过程。以下是会员内容的两个示例。开头部分公开；其余部分由会员阅读。

Are physical rewards available now?

No. Physical rewards belong to the future crowdfunding campaign, once printing, packaging, and shipping have been modelled.

现在有实物回馈吗？

没有。实物回馈属于未来的众筹活动，待印刷、包装和运输都测算完毕之后。
Social & community manager — grow and run the TikTok, Discord, and Instagram, and steward the Moot, where readers help shape the world around the book
社交 & 社群管理——发展并运营 TikTok、Discord 和 Instagram，并主理议会，让读者参与塑造本书周边的世界

Prefer email? Get the same publication milestones straight to your inbox — no
        Patreon account needed. One message when there's real news; unsubscribe any time.
更喜欢邮件？把同样的出版里程碑直接送到你的收件箱——无需 Patreon 账户。有真正的消息时才发一封；随时可退订。

If that sounds like something you'd want on your shelf, the best thing you can do
          right now costs nothing — follow along. Everything else grows from there.
如果这听起来像是你想摆上书架的一本书，那么你此刻能做的最好的事分文不费——一路跟随。其余的一切都从这里生长开来。

These are planned, not final — nothing is on sale yet. Formats and prices are
        confirmed when the campaign launches, and free Patreon members hear first.
这些均为计划，并非最终定案——目前尚无任何物品出售。形式与价格将在活动启动时确认，免费的 Patreon 会员将最先获知。

The crowdfunding campaign — separate from Patreon, and still in preparation — is
        where the book itself becomes available. Planned reward types include:
众筹活动——独立于 Patreon，且仍在筹备中——正是本书本身面世之处。计划中的回馈类型包括：
Prefer to read offline? Download the opening as a free PDF — the prologue and the start of Chapter One.
更喜欢离线阅读？下载免费 PDF 版开篇——序章和第一章的开头。
The reading list opens soon — for now, follow free on Patreon.
阅读名单即将开放——目前， 在 Patreon 上免费关注。

Can I follow without paying?

Yes. Free membership (Traveller) gives you updates, selected excerpts, and campaign news.

我可以不付费就关注吗？

可以。免费会员（旅人）为你提供更新、精选节选和活动资讯。

Will members receive the complete manuscript?

No. Selected excerpts are shared. The full manuscript is not released.

会员会收到完整书稿吗？

不会。分享的是精选节选。完整书稿不会发布。

Where can I read a sample?

On the Excerpt page: the prologue and the opening of Chapter One.

我在哪里可以读到试读？

在试读页面：序章和第一章的开头。

Is the book written?

Yes. The Bell of Silence is a completed manuscript of approximately 104,000 words.

这本书写好了吗？

是的。The Bell of Silence 是一份约 104,000 字的完稿。
No canon is sold. No mystery is decided by payment. Support brings access to the work behind the book — not control over the story.
正典不出售。任何谜题都不由付费决定。支持带来的是接触本书背后创作的机会——而非对故事的掌控。

Exact figures will be published from real supplier quotes before the campaign
        opens — a full budget breakdown, not guesses.
确切数字将在活动开启前依据真实的供应商报价公布——是一份完整的预算明细，而非臆测。

New member material goes out regularly. Nothing here spoils
        the story's unanswered questions — those stay with the book.
新的会员素材会定期发布。此处的内容不会剧透故事尚未解答的谜题——那些谜题留给书本本身。
Beta / manuscript readers — read the finished manuscript and give structured feedback before proofreading
试读 / 书稿读者——在校对之前阅读完稿并给出有条理的反馈

When will crowdfunding launch?

There is no date yet. Free Patreon members are notified first.

众筹何时启动？

目前还没有日期。免费的 Patreon 会员将最先收到通知。
For press or enquiries, write to tobias.carneteg@gmail.com.
Joining now — free or paid — secures founding-member recognition and first notice the moment crowdfunding opens.
现在加入——无论免费还是付费——都可获得创始会员致谢，并在众筹开启的那一刻第一时间收到通知。
Join free for publication updates
免费加入以获取出版更新
Patreon may display prices in the visitor's local currency. Memberships can be cancelled through Patreon.
